svg.title: Simon Oakes - what I bring
svg.desc: Twenty-five years, by the numbers: 25+ years in production since 2000, 2,500 VMs under automation, 300+ DNS zones managed and 40+ Ansible roles authored, each drawn to scale. What I bring. Stabilise: Understand the platform, find the real failure modes and reduce operational noise.; Automate: Replace fragile manual steps with code, pipelines, checks and repeatable workflows.; Modernise: Move systems forward without losing reliability, recovery, or the people operating them.; Mentor: Raise the bar across the engineering function as escalation point, reviewer and teacher.; Tool: Small Go and Python CLIs that fit shells, CI, cron and systemd. Built for operators.; AI-assist: Use AI where it improves clarity: summarisation, reporting and human-in-the-loop operations.
